# Holdem

> Holdem is the free Dropover for Windows: a free, open-source (MIT) floating file shelf. Shake your mouse while dragging to summon a holding area for files, folders, and browser images — navigate anywhere, then drop them where needed. Windows 10/11 x64. Built with Tauri + Rust.

## Docs

- [How to use Holdem](https://holdem.iamzub.in/docs): install, summon with mouse-shake or global hotkey, stash, navigate, drop. What you can stash, tips, comparisons.
- [Download](https://holdem.iamzub.in/download): Windows 10/11 x64 installer (.exe). Latest: v3.1.1 — https://github.com/iamzubin/holdem/releases/download/3.1.1/holdem_3.1.1_x64-setup.exe
- [Pricing — free forever](https://holdem.iamzub.in/pricing): 100% free, MIT open-source. No wait timers, no pro unlocks.
- [Changelog](https://holdem.iamzub.in/changelog): v3.1.1 file-drop reliability + thumbnail fixes; v3.1.0 native OLE drops, 25-locale i18n; v3.0.0 first Windows release.
- [Comparisons](https://holdem.iamzub.in/vs): Holdem vs Mac-only/freemium shelf apps
  - [vs Dropover](https://holdem.iamzub.in/vs/dropover)
  - [vs Dropshelf](https://holdem.iamzub.in/vs/dropshelf)
  - [vs Yoink](https://holdem.iamzub.in/vs/yoink)
  - [vs DropPoint](https://holdem.iamzub.in/vs/droppoint)

## How it works

1. Install and launch — Holdem sits in the system tray (enable auto-launch).
2. Start dragging files in Explorer, then shake the mouse — the shelf appears at your cursor. Or press the global hotkey (customizable).
3. Drop files, folders, or browser images onto the shelf; let go of the mouse.
4. Switch folders, apps, or desktops freely; drag items out to finish. Shelf auto-hides when empty.
5. Right-click the tray icon for settings, hotkey, and quick actions.

## Features

- Floating always-on-top shelf (draggable, 165x175, skip-taskbar)
- Shake-to-summon while dragging + global hotkey
- Native Windows OLE drops: Explorer files/folders, web images, URLs, text snippets
- System-tray integration with settings and quick actions
- Auto-launch on login + auto-update (update manifest: https://holdem.iamzub.in/update.json)
- 25 languages, browser-locale detection, RTL layout
- Low memory use (Tauri/Rust backend)

## Roadmap

- URL / text-snippet drops
- Multiple shelves for different tasks
- Custom theme and opacity controls

## FAQ

- Is Holdem really free? Yes — MIT open-source, no paywall, no wait timers (unlike Dropshelf free tier).
- Windows versions? Windows 10 and 11 (x64).
- Dropover/Dropshelf/Yoink alternative? Yes — those are Mac-only or freemium; Holdem brings the shelf workflow to Windows, free.
- How do I summon it? Shake while dragging, or the global hotkey.
- Source code? https://github.com/iamzubin/holdem — bug reports and PRs welcome; translations via Crowdin.
